title: Operation.
officialText:
Personnel hoists and their components shall be operated in accordance with this code and rules promulgated by
the commissioner.
When the hoist is equipped with manual controls, the hoist shall be operated by a competent qualified operator. Only the operator
authorized by the equipment user shall operate the hoist.
